scope.focus: hypothesis-to-experiment translation, parser-failure lineage, fallback semantics, verdict validity and current inheritance
scope.non_overlap: Narrow epistemic/translation lineage only; broad experiment/benchmark chronology remains outside this shard.

lineage.event: Introduced Experiment Lab + Hypothesis Engine with regex-based synthesis and passive/active evaluation. Initial LabConnector aborted an active test when station parsing failed.
Deep audit reported 158 hypothesis experiment parse failures and repaired execution by station-specific templates plus fallback parameters.

Added topical Jaccard relevance gating after unrelated idle thoughts were resolving hypotheses; this is direct historical evidence that an executed evaluation path can be causally unrelated to the claim it updates.
Later maintenance added passive confidence decay for stale hypotheses, preserving service progress but not solving active-test semantic binding.

frozen_head_mechanism.testability: domain mapping OR keyword scan OR explicit experiment marker
frozen_head_mechanism.translation: prediction text inserted into station template
frozen_head_mechanism.execution: tier 1 generated-description parse; tier 2 station parser on prediction/hypothesis/description; tier 3 randomized station-specific default parameters
frozen_head_mechanism.fallback_examples: physics projectile defaults, random RC/RLC/electronics values, random math expressions, random quantum/astronomy/GoL configurations
frozen_head_mechanism.verdict: explicit narration markers first; otherwise confirmation/refutation keyword score; ties become inconclusive
frozen_head_mechanism.passive_relational_evaluation: behavioral keyword counting with exposure-based confidence nudges/refutation
frozen_head_mechanism.revision: refuted hypotheses can auto-create a generic child framed as 'Previous prediction was wrong' with reduced confidence

negative_results.result: A station parser failure was historically an execution blocker; the repair made experiments runnable by supplying randomized default parameters that can be independent of the hypothesis's actual quantitative or causal prediction.
negative_results.impact: RUN_SUCCESS can diverge from TEST_VALIDITY. A successful experiment receipt is not sufficient evidence that the hypothesis was tested.

negative_results.result: Head verdict interpretation may infer confirmation/refutation from generic narration keywords rather than an explicit preregistered observable/predicate bound to the hypothesis.
negative_results.impact: Narration language can become a Goodhartable proxy for empirical outcome and can create false confirmation/refutation.

negative_results.result: Historical unrelated-thought resolution required a later Jaccard relevance gate.
negative_results.impact: Evidence routing must prove relevance before mutating claim state; mere availability of an observation is not causal evidence.

negative_results.result: Auto-revision after refutation can generate a generic meta-statement instead of a new falsifiable mechanism-level hypothesis.
negative_results.impact: Revision depth can look like scientific progress while reducing falsifiability and mechanism specificity.

cross_source_reconciliation.pattern: Operational health can hide semantic invalidity: subconscious history had silently missing transitions / behavior-policy mismatch; hypothesis lab history has successful fallback execution without guaranteed hypothesis-test binding.
cross_source_reconciliation.current_invariant: Every adaptive or experimental transition needs both an execution receipt and a semantic-validity receipt.

cross_source_reconciliation.pattern: Historical Retina showed metric inflation under lenient thresholds/broad phrase emission; hypothesis lab shows analogous proxy inflation risk where narration keywords stand in for preregistered observables.
cross_source_reconciliation.current_invariant: Separate proxy/readout success from task/claim correctness and preserve calibrated falsifiers.

current_inheritance.delta: Add a TEST_BINDING invariant: each hypothesis experiment must persist hypothesis id/version, preregistered prediction, intervention variables/ranges, controlled variables, observable, decision predicate, parser/translation version, actual executed parameters, result payload and verdict function. A fallback may execute for diagnostics but cannot update claim status unless semantic equivalence to the intended test is proven.
Represent experiments as typed transition contracts rather than prose-to-parser best effort. Distinguish COMPILED_TEST_VALID, EXECUTED, RESULT_OBSERVED and CLAIM_UPDATE_AUTHORIZED.
Persist test-binding provenance and actual-vs-intended parameter diffs; prohibit claim-state mutation when binding_valid=false or verdict_source is only uncalibrated narration heuristic.
Lesion/rescue and causal-emergence experiments need preregistered intervention/readout binding; generic simulator success or narration agreement is not causal evidence.

Autonomous research can propose tests, but execution success and model-generated interpretation remain separate from epistemic authority. Claim transitions require deterministic evidence binding or explicit human/validated adjudication.
Candidate-vs-current promotion must bind frozen replay split, thresholds, metrics and acceptance predicate before execution; fallback data paths may not silently become promotion evidence.

cheap_discriminating_tests: Create a physics hypothesis whose prediction specifies a parameter outside station-parser syntax; force Tier-3 fallback and assert claim status remains unchanged because actual parameters are not semantically bound to the prediction.
Inject narration containing both positive generic words and a numerically failed preregistered predicate; assert deterministic predicate wins and narration keywords cannot confirm the hypothesis.
Mutation-test the experiment translator/parser so every dropped prediction field flips binding_valid=false.
Replay the same result payload through two narration phrasings and require identical verdict.
For GWT/Hyperposition lesion-rescue, persist actual intervention vector and compare it byte-for-byte/schema-for-schema against preregistered intervention before authorizing causal claim updates.
